description: Search demand categories for a campaign — the only way to see what Performance Max and Demand Gen campaigns actually matched, since those never appear in get_search_terms. Called with just campaign_id it returns categories with a bucketed monthly search_volume for each. Pass category_id (an id from a previous call) to drill into the individual search terms inside one category; search volume is not available at that level.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID. Required — the API only serves this report one campaign at a time

category_id.description: Drill into one category's individual search terms. Use an id returned by a previous call without this argument

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

days.description: Number of days to look back

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (1-10000). Raise it to reach the long tail — e.g. when cross-referencing against Search Console data. Large values produce large responses

name: get_search_term_insights
